en.s: The Battle of Philippi was the final battle in the Liberators' civil war between the forces of Mark Antony and Octavian (of the Second Triumvirate) and the leaders of Julius Caesar's assassination, Brutus and Cassius, in 42 BC, at Philippi in Macedonia. The Second Triumvirate declared the civil war ostensibly to avenge Julius Caesar's assassination in 44 BC, but the underlying cause was a long-brewing conflict between the Optimates and the Populares.
en.n: Liberators' civil war: Triumvirs Mark Antony and Octavian fight to a draw Caesar's assassins Brutus and Cassius in the first part of the Battle of Philippi, where Cassius commits suicide believing the battle is lost.

zh.s: 公元前42年，马克·安东尼和屋大维（第二次三头同盟成员）率领的军队与刺杀尤利乌斯·凯撒的布鲁图斯和卡西乌斯率领的军队在马其顿腓立比交战，这是解放者内战的最后一战。第二次三头同盟声称发动内战是为了报复公元前44年凯撒遇刺，但深层原因是贵人派与平民派之间长期积累的冲突。
zh.n: 解放者内战：三头同盟成员马克·安东尼和屋大维在腓立比战役第一阶段与凯撒的刺客布鲁图斯、卡西乌斯战成平手；卡西乌斯误以为战败，遂自杀。

en.s: On October 3, 610, Heraclius’ fleet landed at a fort near the Hebdomon, outside the walls of Constantinople, during the revolt against Emperor Phocas.
en.n: The landing preceded Phocas’ overthrow and Heraclius’ coronation on October 5. The date follows the historical calendar.

zh.t: 希拉克略的舰队在君士坦丁堡城外登陆
zh.s: 610年10月3日，在反对皇帝福卡斯的起义期间，希拉克略的舰队抵达君士坦丁堡，在城外赫布多蒙附近的一座要塞登陆。
zh.n: 登陆早于10月5日福卡斯被推翻和希拉克略加冕。日期沿用历史记载的历法。

en.s: The Battle of Gorgan took place in 900, between the Alids of Tabristan and the Samanids of Khorasan at Gorgan, northern Iran. The battle, which took place after the invasion of Khorasan by Muhammad ibn Zayd, ended with a Samanid victory and brought Tabaristan under Samanid control until restoration of Alid rule in 914. Muhammad ibn Zayd, however, was killed in action and his son was captured. The Samanids now demanded the cession of Gurgan, while Muhammad was planning to exploit the turmoil and invade Khurasan himself. Muhammad and his army met with Samanid army under Muhammad ibn Harun al-Sarakhsi at Gurgan, and in the ensuing battle, the Samanids prevailed, and the severely wounded Muhammad was captured. He died on the next day, 3 October 900 (or in August, according to Abu'l-Faraj).

zh.s: 900年，塔巴里斯坦的阿里德王朝与呼罗珊的萨曼王朝在伊朗北部的戈尔甘交战。穆罕默德·伊本·扎伊德入侵呼罗珊后爆发此战，萨曼王朝获胜，并控制塔巴里斯坦，直到914年阿里德王朝复辟。穆罕默德·伊本·扎伊德在战斗中阵亡，其子被俘。萨曼人随后要求割让古尔甘，而穆罕默德则打算趁乱亲自入侵呼罗珊。穆罕默德及其军队在古尔甘遇上穆罕默德·伊本·哈伦·萨拉赫西率领的萨曼军队，最终萨曼军获胜，穆罕默德身受重伤并被俘。他于次日，即900年10月3日去世；阿布·法拉吉则记载其死于8月。

en.s: The Battle of Écija (1039) took place near Écija on 3 October 1039. The forces of the Taifa of Seville led by Ismail ibn Abbad fought the allied forces of the Taifa of Málaga, Taifa of Granada and the Taifa of Carmona. The battle was a response to the Abbadid dynasty expansionist policies in the neighboring Taifas territories.

zh.s: 1039年10月3日，埃西哈战役在埃西哈附近爆发。塞维利亚泰法王国由伊斯梅尔·伊本·阿巴德率领的军队与马拉加、格拉纳达和卡尔莫纳泰法王国的联军交战。此战是对阿巴德王朝扩张邻近泰法领土政策的回应。

en.s: On October 3, 1356, forces led by the Duke of Lancaster began the siege of Rennes in the Duchy of Brittany. The blockade continued into 1357.
en.n: The date follows the historical chronology and has not been converted to the modern Gregorian calendar.

zh.s: 1356年10月3日，兰开斯特公爵率军围攻布列塔尼公国的雷恩，封锁一直持续到1357年。
zh.n: 日期沿用历史记载，未换算为现代公历。

en.s: The Capture of Damascus was a phase of the Ottoman–Mamluk War (1516–1517). After defeating the Mamluk army under Qansuh al-Ghawri at the Battle of Marj Dabiq on 24 August 1516, the Ottoman army under Selim I continued its advance and reached the outskirts of Damascus on 27 September 1516, entering the city center on 3 October.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 占领大马士革是1516年至1517年奥斯曼—马穆鲁克战争的一个阶段。1516年8月24日，奥斯曼军队在马尔吉·达比克战役中击败坎苏·加乌里率领的马穆鲁克军队后，在塞利姆一世率领下继续推进，于9月27日抵达大马士革郊外，并在10月3日进入市中心。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Moncontour occurred on 3 October 1569 between the Catholic forces of King Charles IX of France and the Huguenots during the "Third War" (1568-1570) of the French Wars of Religion.

zh.s: 1569年10月3日，法国宗教战争第三次战争（1568—1570年）期间，法国国王查理九世的天主教军队与胡格诺派交战，史称蒙孔图尔战役。

en.s: The siege of Leiden occurred during the Eighty Years' War in 1573 and 1574, when the Spanish under Francisco de Valdez attempted to capture the rebellious city of Leiden, South Holland, the Netherlands. The siege failed when the city was successfully relieved in October 1574.
en.n: The Siege of Leiden is lifted by the Watergeuzen.

zh.s: 1573年至1574年八十年战争期间，弗朗西斯科·德·巴尔德斯率领的西班牙军队试图攻占荷兰南荷兰省的起义城市莱顿。1574年10月，西班牙军队未能攻下该城，围城战在荷兰海上乞丐军解围后结束。
zh.n: 海上乞丐军解除了莱顿之围。

en.s: The siege of Gvozdansko (Croatian: Opsada Gvozdanskog) was an Ottoman siege of the fort of Gvozdansko in the Kingdom of Croatia in 1577–1578. In the 1570s, the Ottomans intensified their efforts to capture the valley of the Una River. A string of forts along the Una, centred around Gvozdansko and in possession of the Zrinski noble family, formed the main line of defense of Croatia since 1527.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1577年至1578年，奥斯曼军队围攻克罗地亚王国的格沃兹丹斯科要塞。1570年代，奥斯曼帝国加强了夺取乌纳河谷的攻势。自1527年以来，兹林斯基贵族家族拥有、以格沃兹丹斯科为中心的乌纳河沿岸要塞群，一直是克罗地亚的主要防线。

en.s: The Battle of Glenlivet was fought on 3 October 1594 near Allanreid and Morinsh in Scotland.

zh.s: 1594年10月3日，格伦利维特战役在苏格兰阿兰里德和莫林什附近爆发。

en.s: The siege of Esztergom in 1605 was a military engagement between the Habsburg garrison of Esztergom and the Ottoman army led by the grand vizier Lala Mehmed Pasha. The town was captured by the Ottomans.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 埃斯泰尔戈姆围城战（1605年）
zh.s: 1605年，哈布斯堡王朝驻军与拉拉·穆罕默德帕夏大维齐尔率领的奥斯曼军队在埃斯泰尔戈姆交战。奥斯曼军队最终攻占该镇。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The action of 3 October 1624 was a naval engagement that took place near San Pietro Island, Sardinia, during the war against the Barbary corsairs. A squadron of galleys from the Spain (Kingdom of Naples), Grand Duchy of Tuscany and Papal States under Diego Pimentel engaged a squadron of six Algerian ships under Azan Calafate. The Algerians were defeated, their flagship was destroyed, and four ships were captured.

zh.s: 1624年10月3日，西班牙王国（那不勒斯王国）、托斯卡纳大公国和教皇国组成的桨帆船舰队在撒丁岛圣彼得罗岛附近与阿尔及尔舰队交战。迭戈·皮门特尔率领的联军对阵阿赞·卡拉法特指挥的6艘阿尔及尔船只。阿尔及尔舰队战败，旗舰被毁，另有4艘船被俘获。

en.s: The Battle of Wojnicz was fought on October 3, 1655 between forces of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth commanded by Field Crown Hetman Stanisław Lanckoroński and Great Crown Hetman Stanisław Rewera Potocki on one side, and on the other Swedish forces commanded by Charles X Gustav. The battle ended in Swedish victory. In the early stages of the Siege of Krakow, Polish royal units of Hetman Lanckoronski decided to abandon the city, as the situation of the defenders was hopeless. Together with king Jan Kazimierz, the Poles headed eastwards, to Tarnów.

zh.s: 1655年10月3日，波兰立陶宛联邦军队与瑞典军队在沃伊尼奇交战。波军由王冠副大元帅斯坦尼斯瓦夫·兰茨科龙斯基和王冠大元帅斯坦尼斯瓦夫·雷韦拉·波托茨基指挥，瑞典军由卡尔十世·古斯塔夫指挥，最终瑞典获胜。克拉科夫围城战初期，兰茨科龙斯基麾下的波兰王室部队认为守军已无望守住城市，决定撤离。波军与国王扬·卡齐米日一同向东前往塔尔努夫。

en.s: The Battle of Nabe was fought between Danish and Swedish forces at Nabe on October 3 1657. The Swedes attacked the Danish redoubt and successfully captured both Danish commanders and crushed the popular resistance in Jutland as a consequence of the battle.

zh.s: 1657年10月3日，丹麦与瑞典军队在纳贝交战。瑞典军进攻丹麦的堡垒，俘获两名丹麦指挥官，并因此镇压了日德兰半岛的民众抵抗。

en.s: The Battle of Jouami' al-Ulama took place on 3 October 1700 near Sétif, Algeria. It was fought between the armies of the Bey of Tunis Murad III and those of the Deylik of Algiers commanded by the Dey Hadj Mustapha, and a newly elected Bey of Constantine, Ahmed ben Ferhat.

zh.s: 1700年10月3日，朱阿米·乌拉马战役在阿尔及利亚塞提夫附近爆发。突尼斯贝伊穆拉德三世的军队与阿尔及尔摄政区军队交战，后者由阿尔及尔摄政哈吉·穆斯塔法和新当选的君士坦丁贝伊艾哈迈德·本·费尔哈特指挥。

en.s: The siege of Zvornik was a military engagement during the Austro-Turkish War (1716–1718). The Austrians besieged Zvornik held by the Ottomans. The siege ended in fiasco for the Austrians, who suffered heavy losses.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥土战争（1716—1718年）期间，奥地利军队围攻由奥斯曼军队守卫的兹沃尔尼克。奥地利军队损失惨重，围城以惨败告终。

en.s: The Treaty of Niš was a peace treaty signed on 3 October 1739 in Niš (nowadays in Serbia), by the Ottoman Empire and the Russian Empire, to end the Russo-Turkish War (1735–1739). It was preceded by the preliminary Russo-Turkish peace treaty, signed through French mediation on 18 September 1739 in Belgrade, while the peace arrangements were finalized by the treaty of Niš on 3 October.

zh.s: 1739年10月3日，奥斯曼帝国与俄罗斯帝国在尼斯（今属塞尔维亚）签署和平条约，结束1735年至1739年的俄土战争。此前，双方在法国斡旋下于1739年9月18日在贝尔格莱德签署初步和平条约，最终于10月3日通过《尼斯条约》敲定和平安排。

en.s: The Russo-Turkish War of 1735–1739 between Russia and the Ottoman Empire was caused by the Ottoman Empire's war with Persia and the continuing raids by the Crimean Tatars. The war also represented Russia's ongoing struggle for access to the Black Sea. In 1737, the Habsburg monarchy joined the war on Russia's side, known in historiography as the Austro-Turkish War of 1737–1739.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1735年至1739年，俄罗斯与奥斯曼帝国之间爆发俄土战争，起因包括奥斯曼帝国与波斯交战，以及克里米亚鞑靼人持续发动袭击。这场战争也反映了俄罗斯持续争取进入黑海的努力。1737年，哈布斯堡君主国加入俄罗斯一方参战；历史研究通常将这场冲突称为1737年至1739年奥土战争。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Pasewalk was a battle at Pasewalk of the Seven Years' War between Swedish and Prussian forces fought on October 3, 1760. The Prussian force of 4,200 men under Hans Paul Werner were attempting to seize Pasewalk where a Swedish force of 1,700 men under Augustin Ehrensvärd were stationed. After two failed attacks on the town and several skirmishes outside, the Prussian force, after seven hours of fighting, retreated as the night approached. Casualties on both sides were severe, as Sweden had suffered 500 men in losses, many of them captured by Prussian troops taking the nearby redoubts.

zh.s: 1760年10月3日，七年战争期间，瑞典与普鲁士军队在帕塞瓦尔克交战。汉斯·保罗·维尔纳率领4200名普军试图夺取该城，奥古斯丁·埃伦斯韦德率领的1700名瑞军驻守当地。普军两次攻城失败，城外又发生数次小规模交战。经过7小时战斗，夜色渐浓，普军撤退。双方伤亡都很惨重，瑞典损失500人，其中许多人被攻占附近堡垒的普军俘虏。

en.s: The Sullivan Expedition (also known as the Sullivan-Clinton Expedition, the Sullivan Campaign, and the Sullivan-Clinton Campaign) was a United States military campaign under the command of General John Sullivan during the American Revolutionary War, lasting from June to October 1779, against the four British-allied tribes of the Iroquois Confederacy. The campaign was ordered by George Washington in response to the Haudenosaunee and Loyalist destruction of American settlements in the Wyoming Valley, and Cherry Valley.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 沙利文远征又称沙利文—克林顿远征、沙利文战役或沙利文—克林顿战役，是美国独立战争期间由约翰·沙利文将军指挥的一场军事行动，持续时间为1779年6月至10月，目标是对付与英国结盟的易洛魁联盟四个部族。乔治·华盛顿下令发动远征，以回应豪德诺索尼人和保皇派摧毁怀俄明谷与樱桃谷的美国定居点。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of McIntyre Farm took place on October 3, 1780 between Patriot militia under Captain James Thompson and a combined force of British regulars and Loyalists under Captain John Doyle in northern Mecklenburg county, North Carolina. The event is also known as the "Battle of the Bees" or the "Battle of the Hornets Nest". Lt. General Charles Cornwallis had occupied Charlotte since September 26, 1780.

zh.s: 1780年10月3日，北卡罗来纳州梅克伦堡县北部，詹姆斯·汤普森上尉率领的爱国者民兵与约翰·多伊尔上尉指挥的英军正规部队和效忠派联军交战。这场战斗也称“蜜蜂之战”或“黄蜂窝之战”。查尔斯·康沃利斯中将自1780年9月26日起占领夏洛特。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Slongo (also spelled Salonga) was fought on October 3, 1781 between American Continental Army forces, under the command of Benjamin Tallmadge, and the British defenders of Fort Salonga, in the American Revolutionary War. The fort was located near the border of present-day Huntington Township and Smithtown, New York, overlooking Long Island Sound. The only American wounded in the battle was Sgt. Elijah Churchill who would personally be awarded a Badge of Military Merit by George Washington making him the first person to receive a Purple Heart.

zh.s: 1781年10月3日，美国独立战争期间，本杰明·塔尔米奇指挥的大陆军与守卫斯隆戈堡的英军交战。堡垒位于纽约州亨廷顿镇区与史密斯敦交界附近，可俯瞰长岛海峡。美军在战斗中只有一人受伤，即伊莱贾·丘奇尔中士。乔治·华盛顿后来亲自授予他军事功绩徽章，他因此成为首位获得紫心勋章的人。

en.s: The Battle of Krusi (Albanian: Beteja e Krusit; Serbian: Битка на Крусима, romanized: Bitka na Krusima) was fought on 3 October [O.S. 22 September] 1796 between the campaigning army of Ottoman Empire commanded by Kara Mahmud Pasha, the Pasha of Scutari, and tribes of Prince-Bishopric of Montenegro under the command of Metropolitan Petar I Petrović Njegoš and Jovan Radonjić, at Krusi, Lješanska nahija.

zh.s: 1796年10月3日（儒略历9月22日），奥斯曼帝国军队与黑山公国主教区各部族在克鲁西、列尚斯卡纳希亚交战。奥斯曼军由斯库台帕夏卡拉·马哈茂德帕夏指挥，黑山方面由都主教彼得一世·彼得罗维奇-涅戈什和约万·拉多尼奇指挥。

en.s: The raid on Boulogne in 1804 was a naval assault by elements of the Royal Navy on the fortified French port of Boulogne-sur-Mer, during the Napoleonic Wars. It differed from the conventional tactics of naval assaults of the period by utilizing a wide range of new equipment produced by the American inventor Robert Fulton, with the backing of the Admiralty.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1804年，拿破仑战争期间，英国皇家海军部分兵力袭击了法国设防港口布洛涅滨海城。与当时海军袭击常用的传统战术不同，这次行动使用了多种新装备。这些装备由美国发明家罗伯特·富尔顿设计，并得到英国海军部支持。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Wartenburg (German: Schlacht bei Wartenburg) took place on 3 October 1813 between the French IV Corps commanded by General Henri Gatien Bertrand and the Allied Army of Silesia, principally the I Corps of General Ludwig von Yorck with the personal participation of the army commander, Gebhard L. von Blücher. The battle allowed the Army of Silesia to cross the Elbe, ultimately leading to the Battle of Leipzig.

zh.s: 1813年10月3日，亨利·加蒂安·贝特朗将军指挥的法军第4军与西里西亚联军交战。联军主要由路德维希·冯·约克将军指挥的第1军组成，军队统帅格布哈德·L·冯·布吕歇尔也亲自参与。此战使西里西亚军团得以渡过易北河，最终促成莱比锡战役。

en.s: The 1820 Delaware gubernatorial special election was held on October 3, 1820. The winner of the 1819 gubernatorial election, Henry Molleston, died before assuming office, elevating State Senate Speaker Jacob Stout to the governorship and triggering an election in 1820. However, the election was not just for the remainder of Molleston's term, but instead for a full three-year term.

zh.s: 1820年10月3日，特拉华州举行州长特别选举。1819年州长选举的胜选者亨利·莫尔斯顿在就职前去世，州参议院议长雅各布·斯托特接任州长，并因此触发1820年选举。此次选举并非只选出剩余任期的州长，而是选出一名任期完整的州长，任期为3年。

en.s: The 1825 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 3, 1825, to elect the governor of Georgia. It was the first popular election for governor in Georgia's history following its adoption by the Georgia General Assembly a year prior. The election was between two long-time political rivals, then-Governor George Troup (Democratic-Republican and later Jacksonian Democrat) and independence war hero John Clark (Democratic-Republican).

zh.s: 1825年10月3日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。这是该州历史上首次由选民直接选举州长，此前一年佐治亚州议会通过了相关制度。竞选双方是长期政敌、时任州长乔治·特鲁普（民主共和党，后来成为杰克逊民主党人）和独立战争英雄约翰·克拉克（民主共和党）。

en.s: The 1826 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 3, 1826. Incumbent Federalist Governor Samuel Paynter was barred from seeking re-election to a second consecutive term. State Senator Charles Polk Jr. ran as the Federalist nominee to succeed Paynter, while 1823 Democratic-Republican nominee David Hazzard once again ran as his party's nominee. Polk defeated Hazzard by a narrow margin, barely holding onto the governorship for the Federalists.

zh.s: 1826年10月3日，特拉华州举行州长选举。现任联邦党州长塞缪尔·佩恩特因不得连续连任而不能参选。州参议员查尔斯·波尔克二世作为联邦党候选人参选，接替佩恩特；1823年民主共和党候选人大卫·哈扎德再次代表该党参选。波尔克以微弱优势击败哈扎德，使联邦党勉强保住州长职位。

en.s: The 1831 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 3, 1831, to elect the governor of Georgia. Incumbent Jacksonian Troup Governor George Rockingham Gilmer, first elected in the 1829 election, ran for re-election to a second term. He was narrowly defeated by the Jacksonian Union nominee, U.S House Representative Wilson Lumpkin.

en.s: The 1842 Wellington mayoral election was the first election ever held in New Zealand. It was held to elect a mayor and eleven member council. The mayor was not elected separately, with the position awarded to the highest polling council candidate.

en.s: The Uprising in Nagykanizsa was a revolt during the Hungarian War of Independence of 1848-1849 on 3 October 1848, of the population of this town, helped by the Hungarian national and militias led by József Vidos, the vice-ispán of Vas, against the Croatian occupation army led by Lieutenant Colonel Albert Nugent. The Croatian army occupied the city of Nagykanizsa and Zala county as a result of Ban Josip Jelačić's campaign against Hungary, which started on 11 September 1848.

zh.s: 1848年10月3日，匈牙利独立战争期间，瑙吉考尼饶镇民众在匈牙利民族军和民兵协助下发动起义，反抗克罗地亚占领军。匈牙利部队由沃什州副行政长约瑟夫·维多什率领；克罗地亚军队由阿尔伯特·纽金特中校指挥。班·约瑟普·耶拉契奇于1848年9月11日开始对匈牙利发动攻势，此后克军占领了该市及佐洛州。

en.s: The Battle of Greenbrier River, also known as the Battle of Camp Bartow, took place on October 3, 1861 in Pocahontas County, Virginia (now West Virginia) as part of the Operations in Western Virginia Campaign during the American Civil War.

en.s: The Second Battle of Corinth (which, in the context of the American Civil War, is usually referred to as the Battle of Corinth, to differentiate it from the Siege of Corinth earlier the same year) was fought October 3–4, 1862, in Corinth, Mississippi. For the second time in the Iuka-Corinth Campaign, Union Maj. Gen. William Rosecrans defeated a Confederate army, this time one under Maj. Gen. Earl Van Dorn. After the Battle of Iuka, Maj. Gen. Sterling Price marched his army to meet with Van Dorn's.

zh.s: 第二次科林斯战役发生于1862年10月3日至4日，地点在密西西比州科林斯。在美国内战背景下，这场战役通常简称“科林斯战役”，以区别于同年早些时候的科林斯围城战。在伊乌卡—科林斯战役期间，联邦军少将威廉·罗斯克兰斯第二次击败南方邦联军队；这次对手是厄尔·范多恩少将率领的部队。伊乌卡战役后，斯特林·普赖斯少将率军前去与范多恩会合。

en.s: The Joint Expedition Against Franklin was a joint engagement between the United States Army and Navy against the Confederate States Army during the American Civil War. The engagement was intended to move Union forces into an area where Confederate forces were gathering as they prepared to move on Suffolk, Virginia. Originally planned as a coordinated two-pronged attack with a naval flotilla supporting an infantry advance on Franklin, Virginia, communications delays caused the Navy to start the mission before the Army was ready to support it. Instead, 3 October 1862 found Union Naval forces on the Blackwater River greatly outnumbered by Confederate infantrymen and ultimately forced to retreat.

zh.t: 联合远征富兰克林行动
zh.s: 美国内战期间，美国陆军和海军联合对南方邦联军队展开行动，试图将联邦军调往南方邦联集结、准备进攻弗吉尼亚州萨福克的地区。行动原计划由海军舰队支援步兵推进，对弗吉尼亚州富兰克林发动两路协同进攻；但通讯延误，海军在陆军尚未准备好支援时就先行出动。1862年10月3日，黑水河上的联邦海军兵力远少于南方邦联步兵，最终被迫撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Miahuatlán took place on 3 October 1866 in the vicinity of the current municipality of Miahuatlán de Porfirio Díaz in the state of Oaxaca, Mexico. It was fought between elements of the Mexican republican army under General Porfirio Díaz and troops of the Second Mexican Empire during the French intervention in Mexico. The Imperial troops were defeated, opening the way for Díaz to advance on the city of Oaxaca.

zh.s: 1866年10月3日，米亚瓦特兰战役发生在墨西哥瓦哈卡州现今米亚瓦特兰-德波菲里奥·迪亚斯市镇附近。墨西哥共和军波菲里奥·迪亚斯将军麾下部队与第二墨西哥帝国军队在法国干涉墨西哥战争期间交战。帝国军战败，为迪亚斯向瓦哈卡城推进打开了道路。

en.s: The Battle of Perecué, also known as Battle of Tayí Island, was an armed action that occurred during the Paraguayan War. Paraguayan general Bernardino Caballero's troops launched guerrilla-style raids on the Allied encampment in the Tayí area, near the Humaitá Fortress.

zh.s: 佩雷库埃战役又称塔伊岛战役，是巴拉圭战争期间的一次武装冲突。贝纳迪诺·卡瓦列罗将军率领的巴拉圭军队在塔伊地区对盟军营地发动游击式突袭，该地区靠近乌迈塔要塞。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 3 October 1911 to elect 50 members to the Western Australian Legislative Assembly. The Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader John Scaddan, defeated the conservative Ministerialist government led by Premier Frank Wilson. In doing so, Scaddan achieved Labor's first absolute majority on the floor of the Assembly and, with 68% of the seats (34 of 50), set a record for Labor's biggest majority in Western Australia.

zh.s: 1911年10月3日，西澳大利亚州举行选举，选出50名州立法议会议员。由反对党领袖约翰·斯卡丹领导的工党击败了由州长弗兰克·威尔逊领导的保守派部长政府。斯卡丹因此使工党首次在州议会中取得绝对多数，并以34席（共50席，占68%）创下该州工党多数席位的纪录。

en.s: The Battle of Coyotepe Hill was a significant engagement during the United States occupation of Nicaragua from August through November 1912 during the insurrection staged by Minister of War General Luis Mena against the government of President Adolfo Díaz. Coyotepe is an old fortress located on a 500-foot hill overlooking the strategic railroad line near Masaya roughly halfway between Managua and Granada, Nicaragua.

en.s: The first-ever elections to Philippine Senate were held on October 3, 1916, immediately after the passage of the Philippine Autonomy Act, known as the Jones Law. The Act created the Senate of the Philippines. The Senate replaced the Philippine Commission as the upper house of the Philippine Legislature, thus creating for the first time a fully elected national legislative branch in the Philippines, under the American colonial Insular Government. Each district elected two senators (plurality-at-large): The first-placer was to serve a six-year term while the second-placer was to serve a three-year term. On each election thereafter, one seat per district was up (first past the post).

zh.s: 菲律宾首次参议院选举于1916年10月3日举行，时间紧接《菲律宾自治法》（又称《琼斯法案》）通过之后。该法案设立菲律宾参议院。参议院取代菲律宾委员会，成为菲律宾立法机关的上院，由此在美国殖民政府统治下首次建立了完全由选举产生的国家立法机关。每个选区选出两名参议员，按得票排序：第一名任期6年，第二名任期3年。此后每次选举，各选区有一个席位改选，采用简单多数制。

en.s: The Capture of Eaucourt l'Abbaye (1–3 October 1916) was a tactical incident during the Battle of the Somme. Eaucourt is about 16 mi (26 km) south of Arras, at the junction of the D 929 and the D 10E roads. Eaucourt l'Abbaye (Eaucourt) is north-west of Martinpuich, south-east of Le Sars, south of the Butte de Warlencourt west of Gueudecourt and north-west of Flers.

en.s: The Battle of Polygon Wood (26 September to 3 October 1917) was fought during the second part of the Third Battle of Ypres in the First World War. The battle was fought near Ypres in Belgium, from the Menin road to Polygon Wood and thence north, to the area beyond St Julien. Much of the woodland had been destroyed by the huge bombardments from both sides since 16 July and the area had changed hands several times.

en.t: The Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes is renamed Yugoslavia
en.s: On October 3, 1929, King Alexander changed the official name of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes to the Kingdom of Yugoslavia.

zh.t: 塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国更名为南斯拉夫王国
zh.s: 1929年10月3日，亚历山大国王将塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国的正式国名改为南斯拉夫王国。

en.s: The Second Italo-Ethiopian War, also referred to as the Second Italo-Abyssinian War, was a war of aggression waged by Italy against Ethiopia, which lasted from October 1935 to May 1936. In Ethiopia it is often referred to simply as the Italian Invasion (Amharic: ጣልያን ወረራ, romanized: Ṭalyan warära), and in Italy as the Ethiopian War (Italian: Guerra d'Etiopia). The war is regarded as the largest colonial campaign in history. On 3 October 1935, two hundred thousand soldiers of the Regio Esercito (Royal Army) commanded by Marshal Emilio De Bono attacked from Italian Eritrea without prior declaration of war.

zh.t: 第二次意大利—埃塞俄比亚战争
zh.s: 第二次意大利—埃塞俄比亚战争又称第二次意大利—阿比西尼亚战争，是意大利对埃塞俄比亚发动的侵略战争，持续时间为1935年10月至1936年5月。在埃塞俄比亚，这场战争通常简称“意大利入侵”（阿姆哈拉语：ጣልያን ወረራ，转写：Ṭalyan warära）；在意大利则称“埃塞俄比亚战争”（意大利语：Guerra d'Etiopia）。这被认为是历史上规模最大的殖民战争。1935年10月3日，埃米利奥·德·博诺元帅指挥20万意大利王家陆军士兵从意属厄立特里亚发起进攻，事先未宣战。

en.s: The Lingiades massacre, on 3 October 1943, was a Nazi German war crime committed by members of the 1st Mountain Division of the Wehrmacht Heer during the Axis occupation of Greece. The village of Lingiades (Greek: Λιγκιάδες), near Ioannina in northwestern Greece, was arbitrarily chosen as a target for reprisals by the Wehrmacht due to the killing of a German officer by members of the Greek Resistance.

en.s: Operation Pistol was the code name for a Special Air Service mission during the Second World War, with the objective to parachute four teams from 'A' Squadron 2nd Special Air Service behind the German lines around the Alsace–Lorraine region of France. Once on the ground they would attempt to disrupt the road and rail networks between Metz and Nancy and the approach to the Rhine plain.

en.t: Establishment of World Federation of Trade Unions
en.s: The World Federation of Trade Unions (WFTU) is an international federation of trade unions established on October 3, 1945. Founded in the immediate aftermath of World War II, the organization built on the pre-war legacy of the International Federation of Trade Unions as a single structure for trade unions world-wide, following the World Trade Union Conference in London, United Kingdom.

zh.s: 世界工会联合会（WFTU）是一个国际工会联合组织，成立于1945年10月3日。该组织在第二次世界大战刚结束后成立，承接了战前国际工会联合会的传统；此前，伦敦举行了世界工会大会，随后各国工会以这一联合组织的形式汇聚起来。

en.t: 1946 American Overseas Airlines Douglas DC-4 crash
en.s: On October 3, 1946, an American Overseas Airlines (AOA) Douglas DC-4 aircraft named Flagship New England crashed soon after take-off from Stephenville, Newfoundland, killing all 39 people on board. It was, at the time, the deadliest aircraft crash on Canadian soil.

en.s: General elections were held in Brazil on 3 October 1950. The presidential elections were won by Getúlio Vargas of the Brazilian Labour Party, whilst the Social Democratic Party remained the largest party in both the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate, although they lost their majority in the former. Voter turnout was 72.1% in the presidential election, 72.0% in the Chamber elections and 77.7% in the Senate elections.

en.s: The First Battle of Maryang-san (3–8 October 1951), also known as the Defensive Battle of Maliangshan (Chinese: 馬良山防衛戰; pinyin: Mǎliáng Shān Fángyù Zhàn), was fought during the Korean War between United Nations Command (UN) forces—primarily Australian, British and Canadian—and the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA). The fighting occurred during a limited UN offensive by US I Corps, codenamed Operation Commando.

zh.s: 第一次马良山战役发生于1951年10月3日至8日，又称马良山防御战（中文：马良山防御战；拼音：Mǎliáng Shān Fángyù Zhàn）。朝鲜战争期间，联合国军（主要由澳大利亚、英国和加拿大部队组成）与中国人民志愿军在此交战。战斗发生在联合国军的一次有限攻势期间，该攻势由美国第1军团实施，代号“突击队行动”。

en.s: Operation Hurricane was the first test of a British atomic device. A plutonium implosion device was detonated on 3 October 1952 in Main Bay, Trimouille Island, in the Montebello Islands in Western Australia. With the success of Operation Hurricane, the United Kingdom became the third nuclear power, after the United States and the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 飓风行动是英国首次核武器试验。1952年10月3日，英国在西澳大利亚蒙特贝罗群岛特里穆耶岛的缅因湾引爆了一枚钚内爆装置。飓风行动成功后，英国成为继美国和苏联之后的第三个核武器国家。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Brazil on 3 October 1960. Jânio Quadros of the National Labour Party, helming a coalition of the PTN, the National Democratic Union and the Christian Democratic Party, won a sweeping victory, taking 48.3% of the vote. Voter turnout was 81.0%. Quadros' victory was the largest in Brazilian history at the time; the 15.6 percent margin of victory would remain a record until Fernando Henrique Cardoso won by 27 points in 1994. His victory marked the first time in 31 years that the presidency had not been won by an heir to the legacy of Getúlio Vargas.

zh.s: 1960年10月3日，巴西举行总统选举。国家劳工党候选人雅尼奥·夸德罗斯领导由国家劳工党、国家民主联盟和基督教民主党组成的联盟，以48.3%的得票率大胜，投票率为81.0%。当时，夸德罗斯的胜利是巴西历史上优势最大的一次；其15.6个百分点的胜选差距直到1994年费尔南多·恩里克·卡多佐以27个百分点获胜才被打破。这也是31年来首次由并非继承热图利奥·瓦加斯政治遗产的人赢得总统职位。

en.t: Mercury-Atlas 8, the fifth United States crewed space mission, was launched from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida, carrying astronaut Wally Schirra (pictured)
en.s: Mercury-Atlas 8 (MA-8) was the fifth United States crewed space mission, part of NASA's Mercury program. Astronaut Walter M. Schirra Jr., orbited the Earth six times in the Sigma 7 spacecraft on October 3, 1962, in a nine-hour flight focused mainly on technical evaluation rather than on scientific experimentation. This was the longest U.S. crewed orbital flight yet achieved in the Space Race, though well behind the several-day record set by the Soviet Vostok 3 earlier in the year.

zh.t: 水星—擎天神8号载人航天任务发射
zh.s: 水星—擎天神8号（MA-8）是美国第五次载人航天任务，属于NASA水星计划。1962年10月3日，宇航员小沃尔特·M·席拉驾驶“西格玛7号”飞船绕地球飞行6圈，任务历时9小时，重点是技术评估而非科学实验。这是当时美国最长的一次载人轨道飞行，但远不及苏联“东方3号”在当年创下的数日飞行纪录。

en.s: The 1963 Honduran coup d'état was a military takeover of the Honduran government on 3 October 1963, ten days before a scheduled election. Oswaldo López Arellano replaced Ramón Villeda Morales as the President of the country and initiated two decades of military rule. Villeda Morales had instituted progressive labor laws and an agrarian reform policy, which prompted accusations of Communist sympathies from the right wing in Honduras and the United States. His intention to expropriate land from United Fruit Company, though never carried out, was a particular source of friction. Civil–military relations in Honduras had deteriorated since 1957.

zh.s: 1963年10月3日，洪都拉斯军方在原定选举前10天接管政府。奥斯瓦尔多·洛佩斯·阿雷利亚诺取代拉蒙·比列达·莫拉莱斯出任总统，并开启了长达20年的军人统治。比列达·莫拉莱斯推行了进步的劳工法和土地改革政策，因此被洪都拉斯右翼及美国指责同情共产主义。他打算征收联合果品公司的土地，虽未实施，却成为双方关系紧张的一个重要原因。自1957年以来，洪都拉斯的军民关系一直在恶化。

en.s: The 1968 Peruvian coup d'état took place during the first presidency of Fernando Belaúnde (1963–1968) as a result of political disputes becoming the norm, serious arguments between President Belaúnde and Congress, dominated by the APRA-UNO (Unión Nacional Odríista) coalition, and even clashes between the president and his own Acción Popular (Popular Action) party. Congress went on to censor several cabinets of the Belaúnde administration, and a general political instability was perceived.

zh.s: 1968年秘鲁政变发生在费尔南多·贝朗德首次担任总统期间（1963—1968年）。当时政治争端已成常态，贝朗德总统与国会之间冲突严重，而国会由美洲人民革命联盟—奥德里斯塔全国联盟（APRA-UNO）主导；总统与自己所属的人民行动党也发生冲突。国会随后谴责了贝朗德政府的多个内阁，政局普遍动荡。

en.t: The U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration is established

en.s: The third local elections in Iran were held on 3 October 1972 to elect the members of city and town municipal councils. People's Party won only 1.5% of total votes in Tehran, while in the provinces New Iran Party had more than 90% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1972年10月3日，伊朗举行第三次地方选举，选出市镇议会成员。正如预期，新伊朗党超过人民党，赢得80%的选票。在全国3786个席位中，该党赢得3246席。人民党在德黑兰仅获得1.5%的总票数，而新伊朗党在各省的得票率均超过90%。

en.s: The Battle of Ap Da Bien was a battle in the Vietnam War, which took place at dawn of October 3, 1973 when the 207th Regiment of the Viet Cong's army-People's Liberation Armed Forces of South Vietnam (PLAF) was raided by forces of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam while sheltering near the hamlet of Ap Da Bien in Thạnh Hóa District, Long An Province. The 207th Regiment was established in 1970 by Viet Cong in Cambodia According to the 207th Regiment's website, the battle resulted in the death of over 79 soldiers of the PLAF 207th Regiment, of whom most were ex-students of the Hanoi University of Civil Engineering.

zh.s: 越南战争期间，阿普达边战役于1973年10月3日黎明时分爆发。越南共和国军突袭了越共军队（南越人民解放武装力量）第207团；该团当时驻扎在隆安省盛化县阿普达边村附近。第207团由越共于1970年在柬埔寨组建。根据该团网站记载，战斗造成第207团79名以上士兵死亡，其中多数曾就读于河内土木工程大学。

en.s: The 1982 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final was the ninth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1982 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship, an inter-county ladies' Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 3 October 1999. Although the Social Democratic Party remained the largest party in the National Council, a right-wing coalition government was formed by the Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ) and the Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) after several months of negotiations. Although the FPÖ had finished a fraction of a point ahead of the ÖVP in the popular vote, ÖVP leader Wolfgang Schüssel became Chancellor rather than controversial FPÖ leader Jörg Haider. en.s: Ultimate Fight Night 2 was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on October 3, 2005. The event took place at the Hard Rock Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, and was broadcast live on Spike TV in the United States and Canada. The broadcast drew a 1.6 overall rating while going head-to-head with USA Network's World Wrestling Entertainment in a heated ratings battle. en.s: K-1 WORLD MAX 2007 World Championship Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the sixth annual K-1 World MAX final for middleweight kickboxers (70 kg/154 lb weight class), involving eight finalists and four reserve fighters, with all bouts fought under K-1 rules. Seven of the finalists had won elimination fights at the K-1 World MAX 2007 World Tournament Final Elimination, while the eighth, Gago Drago, had been invited despite losing his elimination match.

zh.s: 2008年10月3日，库尔德工人党（PKK）袭击了哈卡里省谢姆丁利县阿克图屯宪兵边防站，目标是在边防哨所执勤的义务兵。原文将PKK描述为马克思列宁主义恐怖组织，并称其被美国、欧盟、土耳其等认定为恐怖组织。

en.s: The Battle of Kamdesh took place during the War in Afghanistan (2001–2014). It occurred on October 3, 2009, when a force of 300 Taliban assaulted the American Combat Outpost ("COP") Keating near the town of Kamdesh of Nuristan province in eastern Afghanistan. The attack was the bloodiest battle for US forces since the Battle of Wanat in July 2008, which occurred 20 miles (32 km) away from Kamdesh. The attack on COP Keating resulted in 8 Americans killed and 27 wounded whilst the Taliban suffered an estimated 150 killed.

zh.s: 坎大哈战役发生在阿富汗战争（2001—2014年）期间。2009年10月3日，约300名塔利班武装人员袭击了阿富汗东部努里斯坦省坎大哈镇附近的美军基廷战斗前哨。自2008年7月万纳特战役以来，这是美军伤亡最惨重的一场战斗；万纳特距坎大哈约20英里（32公里）。袭击造成8名美国人死亡、27人受伤；据估计，塔利班方面有150人死亡。

en.s: General elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 3 October 2010 for both the Federal government and the two entities. Voters elected 42 deputies to the State House of Representatives. In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBiH), 98 deputies to its House of Representatives, two representatives (one Bosniak, one Croat) to the tripartite state presidency and ten cantonal assemblies were elected. en.s: The 2010 Bahia gubernatorial election was held on October 3 as part of the general elections in Brazil. In this election, Bahian citizens eligible to vote decided incumbent Governor Jaques Wagner, of the center-left Workers' Party, should receive a new four-year term. His main challengers were former Governor Paulo Souto, of the right wing Democrats, and Minister for National Integration Geddel Vieira Lima, of centrist Brazilian Democratic Movement Party.

en.s: The 2011 Northwest Territories general election was held on October 3, 2011. Nineteen members were returned to the 17th Legislative Assembly from single member districts conducted under first-past-the-post voting system. The territory operates on a consensus government system with no political parties; the premier is subsequently chosen by and from the Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs). Three incumbent MLAs faced no challengers and were acclaimed back into office in their districts.

en.s: The 2011 Prince Edward Island general election was held on October 3, 2011. The Liberal government of Premier Robert Ghiz was elected to a second majority government, winning one seat less than they did in 2007. Ghiz himself considered 18 seats to be a marker for a strong majority. He won 22. Health care was an important issue during the election, especially in rural areas.

en.s: The 2012 United States presidential debates were a series of debates held during the 2012 presidential election. The Commission on Presidential Debates (CPD), a bipartisan organization formed in 1987, organized four debates among the major party candidates, sponsored three presidential debates and one vice presidential debate. en.s: On 3 October 2013, a boat carrying migrants from Libya to Italy sank off the Italian island of Lampedusa. en.t: WWE Live from Madison Square Garden
en.s: Live from Madison Square Garden, also called Live from MSG: Lesnar vs. Big Show, was a professional wrestling event produced by WWE. It took place on October 3, 2015 and aired exclusively on the WWE Network. The event was hailed as part one of Brock Lesnar's Go To Hell Tour and his return to Madison Square Garden in his first match in the arena since his original departure from the company in 2004. The event also marked the 25-year anniversary of Chris Jericho's debut in professional wrestling.

en.t: 2023 Speaker of the House of Commons of Canada election
en.s: The 2023 election for Speaker of the House of Commons of Canada took place on October 3, 2023, to elect the 38th speaker of the House of Commons, following the resignation of Speaker Anthony Rota.
